players.product: memory (DRAM / NAND) and display-driver assembly & test

quarterly_data.signal: ChipMOS July 2026 unaudited consolidated revenue was NT$2,823.0 million (US$87.5 million), up 11.2% from June 2026 and up 43.6% from July 2025 (NT$1,965.9 million) - a new record high monthly revenue level since 2014. The company said it continues to benefit from a persistent AI-related demand/supply imbalance, is working closely with customers on their near- and long-term needs, and remains disciplined in footprint expansion, with new capacity being used to meet customers' demands.
